changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 9 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/5926-empty-action-visible-when.md`

- names `packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx` → `packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx` — edited by this change

  > `visibleWhen` is not a per-block concern in this platform. It is enforced **once, generically**, in `packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx`: `shouldHide` tests `visibleWhen` ahead of the hoisted `visible` (objectui#5454), sets `_hidden`, and the `_hidden` early return fires **before** the registry dispatches. A block renderer cannot ignore the gate, because it never sees the node.

### `.changeset/6051-gantt-flat-config-declared-keys.md`

- names `packages/types/src/index.ts` → `packages/types/src/index.ts` — edited by this change

  > **`GanttConfig` itself gains nine members and is a published type**, exported by name from `packages/types/src/index.ts`: `lockField`, `objectField`, `summaryExtent`, `defaultCollapsedDepth`, `borderColorField`, `dependencyTypes`, `timeZone`, `exportFileName`, `interactions`. The entry file's diff is empty only because the export list already named the type — the widening happened at the declaration.

### `.changeset/7319-dead-schemarenderer-retired.md`

- names `packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx` → `packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx` — edited by this change

  > `packages/components/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx` was a 28-line component carrying the same export name as the real renderer in `packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx`. Nothing reached it: it is absent from the package barrel, no file in the repo imports it by any form, and the package's `exports` map has no subpath that resolves to it.

### `.changeset/7415-action-type-input-rename.md`

- names `SchemaRenderer.tsx` → `packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx` — edited by this change

  > **Census of the authored corpus, measured before the rename, not assumed.** Across 4,797 files in `examples/`, `apps/console/`, `content/docs/` and `packages/`: **zero** authored nodes set the input. 517 JSON files (433 of them the schema catalog) contain 2,410 `type`-bearing nodes and **no** `action:button` / `action:icon` node at all — control: 127 plain `button` nodes on the same walk. 207 parsed fenced JSON blocks in md/mdx carry **5** `action:button` nodes, all of them `{ type, label, icon?, action }` — the discriminator plus the `action` channel, none setting an execution type — control: 28 plain `button` nodes, and the count independently matches the corpus census already recorded in `SchemaRenderer.tsx` ("`action:button` (5 nodes)"). No docs page documents the input; no catalog entry uses the components. So the rename breaks no authored document in this repo.

### `.changeset/7912-schema-renderer-datasource-contract.md`

- names `packages/react/README.md` → `packages/react/README.md` — edited by this change

  > Five `as any` reads of this context in `@object-ui/fields` are gone — they were redundant the moment the seam became honest — and `LookupField`'s local re-declaration of the imported context as a `Context` of `any`, which laundered its `dataSource` read while looking typed, is gone with them. Both directions of the contract are pinned against the real compiler in `SchemaRendererContext.dataSourceType.pin.test.ts`, and the card's planted documentation probe (a bare string in `packages/react/README.md`'s provider example) now fails `pnpm check:doc-snippets`, where it used to exit 0 with zero diagnostics.

### `.changeset/8284-content-channel-per-component.md`

- names `packages/react/README.md` → `packages/react/README.md` — edited by this change

  > **Migration.** Nothing that renders today stops rendering: a document authoring the channel its renderer reads is unchanged, and a document authoring the other one rendered an empty element before and is now refused instead. The repo-wide census found five documents in this state — `packages/react/README.md`, `content/docs/guide/expressions.md`, two blocks in `content/docs/guide/schema-rendering.md` and `packages/components/TESTING.md` — every one of them a `form` or `container` authoring `body`; all five are corrected in this change. If your own metadata authors the refused channel on one of these twelve node types, the component was already drawing nothing there; rename the key to the one in the table.

### `.changeset/9959-refused-data-prop-warn-reset.md`

- names `SchemaRenderer.tsx` → `packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx` — edited by this change

  > The dedupe `Set` behind the objectui#9571 / objectui#9758 diagnostic — "the authored `data` key was NOT passed to the component as a React prop" — lived in `SchemaRenderer.tsx` with nothing able to clear it, while every other dev diagnostic in this package's `utils/` directory pairs its `Set` with an exported test-only reset. `propsBagDiagnostic.ts` states the consequence in its own reset's docblock: the second test to assert the same warning reads the first test's dedupe entry and sees silence, "a green run that checked nothing". The absence direction is the dangerous one — a test asserting this warning did NOT fire for a `type#id` an earlier test already warned for is green whatever the renderer does, and it reports that green as coverage.

### `.changeset/component-meta-converge-and-deprecate-alias-5893.md`

- names `packages/types/src/index.ts` → `packages/types/src/index.ts` — edited by this change

  > ⚠️ **Dated note, 2026-09-29 — the one-occurrence reading above has since moved — objectui#10979.** "In-repo, `PluginComponentMeta` has exactly one occurrence — its own export line" above is the reading of the commit this change landed on (`575b71c850`), where a whole-tree search for the name returned that one line, in `packages/types/src/index.ts`. This change then added its own pins and this entry, and later in this same release objectui#5674's retirement of the sibling alias `PluginComponentInput` (PR objectui#10826) added mentions in its test and its entry. Re-measured on `main` at `2eaf5be27`, the name occurred on 19 lines in 7 files. In non-test source it appeared only on the export line and on one doc-comment line in `plugin-scope.ts`, and the one file that imported it was this change's own `component-meta-single-declaration.test.ts`. The text above is kept as the reading of this change.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `3c3ce15a7` (merge-base with origin/main): 12 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1937 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2558 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36880328958)

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `29acb0107f6c18942705d0e2f56671461b03a175`
Local-runs: none

Inputs: card #11364 (body and its 3 comments), PR #11385 (body, 14 files, the net diff against merge-base `edfcf5a5e`), and the head's 43 check-runs, read at 2026-10-01T14:40Z: 40 success, 3 skipped (`Test (coverage)`, `Test (coverage shard …/4)`, `dependabot`, all conditional), none in progress. Repository files were read at the head with `git show`; the spec at objectstack `0f6dcac5e9` (`@objectstack/spec` 17.5.0) and `@objectstack/lint`'s `validate-component-props.ts` at the same commit. The dev report `5933487223`, the ACCEPT `5933537099` and the PR body were read as claims.

Rendered 2026-10-01T14:44Z.

### ① Derived judgments

**Right.**

1. `PublicBlockNode` is `ClosedArmInput` over `(typeof PublicBlockComponentSchema)['options'][number]`: one member per arm (27 at the head, `public-blocks.zod.ts` 1146-1174), each the `z.input` of a `z.ZodObject` rebuilt from the arm's `shape` under the default strip config. By reference, no twin. Closing the bag is the right reading: the zod `BaseSchema` is `.passthrough()` (`base.zod.ts:486`), so a bare `z.input` of an arm carries `[k: string]: unknown`, which would put objectui#8347's removed signature back. What the tolerant arm *accepts* unjudged is that face's business; what it *declares* is the contract (objectui#7927 ruling `5565351677`, "the real extension keys are declared"). Pinned by `_NoMemberIsIndexed` with the bare-input control. The arms' `body` / `children` tombstones are `z.never({ error }).optional()` (`tombstone.zod.ts:64`), so they reach the members as optional never-valued keys; the `9256` note's "`?: never`" holds in effect.
2. `ElementRecordPickerNode.dataSource`: the renderer reads `schema.dataSource` (`record-picker.tsx` 11, 26, 368; `dataSource.filter ?? filter` and the sort / limit precedence). Declaring it by reference to `ElementDataSourceSchema`, as the `element:number` arm does, is right. The bag's `object` left optional is right: `suppliedByDataSource` (`packages/lint/src/validate-component-props.ts` at `0f6dcac5e9`, 169-184) waives an absent `object` at path `['object']` for ANY component whose `dataSource.object` is a string, and its docblock names the showcase's `element:record_picker` as the live specimen. The row (`ElementRecordPickerPropsSchema`) requires `object`; a type cannot carry the waiver's condition, exactly as the `element:number` arm's `z.input` cannot.
3. `PageDocumentNode`: `PageSchema` (`page.zod.ts`, `strictObject`) has `type: PageTypeSchema.default('record')` over `record | home | app | utility | list` and `kind` as the override enum (`full | slotted | html | react | jsx`). The kinds are registered component types (`ComponentRegistry.register('home', PageRenderer, …)`, `page.tsx:804`) that `PageView` hands to `SchemaRenderer` as `type` (objectui#9642). Requiring `type` in the type is right; it is the discriminator.
4. The face split: `AnyComponentSchema` refuses `element:text_input`, `element:record_picker` and the page kinds at `type`. All seven keys are in `KNOWN_SCHEMA_TYPES` (`packages/cli/src/utils/known-schema-types.ts`: `element:record_picker` 125, `element:text_input` 128, `app` 49, `home` 209, `list` 229, `record` 437, `utility` 644), the population `registered-types-validate-ratchet-10859` counts (bare keys under `REFUSED_AT_TYPE`, namespaced under `NAMESPACED_REFUSED_AT_TYPE`). Before this PR the TS face accepted every one of them incidentally (`BaseSchema`'s `type: string` plus the index signature); the PR names that acceptance. No new split is opened; the report's reading is right.
5. `SchemaRendererProps.schema` is `BaseSchema | AuthoringNode | string | null | undefined`, no index signature, no `Record`; assertion 1 pins it exactly. `toRenderableSchema` returns `SchemaRendererProps['schema']` by reference (`schema-input.ts:74-76`), so assertion 7 still holds and the bridge's return widens with the prop. In-repo, every caller of the bridge (apps/site, data-table, empty, page, header-bar, plugin-detail, plugin-report, plugin-view) forwards the value into the renderer; none reads a key off it. `Type Check` is success on the head.
6. The test retypes weaken no assertion. The `page:tabs` literals move `items` into the bag where `PageTabsProps` declares it (its item carries `label`, `value`, `count`, `children`); the `action:button` literals move `label` / `actionType` into the bag (objectui#11183, AGENTS.md #4) and CASE A keeps the node-level `params` object it proves unread; `required-marker` wraps its literal in `textInputNode`; propsResolution assertion 1 pins the new exact union, a pin moved, not loosened. `Test` and shards 1-8 are success.
7. `SchemaNode` not widened: right. A closed member in a union turns an undeclared read into TS2339 while the signature is still present (the same mechanism as C below). No `zod-mirror-parity` row: right.
